name: Ashiok, Dream Render
oracle_text:
Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause their controller to search their library.
−1: Target player mills four cards. Then exile each opponent's graveyard.
blocked_sentences: Spells and abilities your opponents control can't cause their controller to search their library.

needs.what: a player-wide static (affects_player: "opponent") that makes any search_library / search_zones (library part) effect from a spell or ability controlled by an affected player fail to search when the player searching is that same controller -- the search finds nothing, but the rest of the effect (e.g. shuffle) still happens; searches of other players' libraries, and searches caused by other players' spells, are unaffected
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_effects has cant_cast_spells, cant_activate_abilities and cant_gain_life, but nothing that restricts library searching; search_library carries no hook a static can veto, and no replacement static covers it
